protocol.geometry: Timestamp center09-15UTC,random center in public milepost order;clip contiguous30/70pct sensor segment;3/6h nested cases
protocol.model_policy: All original weights/alphas fixed;no choice from this stress test
protocol.target_population: All raw-public-train eligible station rows inside outage;separate from released Task1 control targets
protocol.zero_target_policy: Retain zero-support cases as unknown;never resample by observed labels
protocol.scores: Conditional channel-scaled reconstruction diagnostic,not official R1/R2/R3 State or Kaggle Total
protocol.data_scope: Dates not used by these weights,previously studied public calendars possible;no hidden split/reference access

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
